title: Rolls of Leather and Coils of Rope
summary: Two loads wait in Marrowick: rolls of leather for Jory Mossop and coils of rope for Silas Pickering. Larkin Fenwick wants them moved before the next cart goes through.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Jory Mossop waits on rolls of leather and Silas Pickering on coils of rope. Fetch them in any order, before the next cart goes through."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 3 rolls of leather from the tannery yard
Take 3 coils of rope from the second stack
Hand the rolls of leather to Jory Mossop
Hand the coils of rope to Silas Pickering
Tell Larkin Fenwick both are in
